facts.text: Task enforcement in `TaskHooksCoordinator.gate` returns a `block` decision for tool calls when no task is focused (`in_progress` and `active`) and `enforcementMode` is `block`; the canonical pipeline defaults to `block`, and TaskManage, planning, interaction, and skill paths stay exempt.

`pi-tern` session resume (`resumeSession` in `.pi/lib/tern/session-resume.ts`) states that Pi replaces the session on switch, invalidating the old ctx, so post-switch work must run inside the `withSession` callback with the ctx it receives.

The `pi()` dispatcher in `.pi/config/tern-pi.zsh` intercepts a bare `pi` only when there are no arguments, stdin and stdout are TTYs, `TERM_PROGRAM` is `tern`, `TERN_PANE` is set, `PI_TERN_UI` is not `0`, the runner is readable, and node is available; otherwise it runs `command pi "$@"`. A leading `-nt` bypasses Tern.
In `.pi/config/tern-pi.zsh`, the runner path defaults to `TREBOL_TERN_RUNNER` but falls back to a hardcoded absolute path under `/Users/swarm/Work/Clover/trebol`, so the fallback is machine-specific.
